title: Seems Like Old Times
note: mentioned by Van during Heaven Can Wait ep, Bill says he has to watch it again, Van says it holds up; mentioned again in National Lampoon's Christmas Vacation ep, Bill says he can't believe they haven't done it yet
plot: After being falsely accused of robbing a bank, a writer seeks the help of his lawyer ex-wife to clear his name. However, hilarity ensues when he must hide from her husband, who’s throwing a party for law enforcement officials.
